assignments.brief: The county is closing two of its five household waste sites. Who decided, on what evidence, and what happens to the tonnage.
A retail park car park has been charging for parking since January without the required signage. How much has been taken and who is liable.
The new footbridge over the Oren has been closed for repairs twice in six months. What is actually wrong with it.
Ambulance handover delays at the county hospital doubled over winter. Establish the figures and what the trust is doing.
A dormant quarry has applied to reopen as an inert waste tip. Trace the ownership and the objections.
Three primary schools have merged catchments without consultation. Find the decision trail and the effect on admissions.
The market hall refurbishment is eighteen months late. Establish the contract history and the cost to date.
A river monitoring station has reported no data since October. Who is responsible for it and what has been missed.
Two bus routes serving the north of the county were withdrawn at short notice. Establish the subsidy history.
A council-owned leisure centre has been shut for safety work since August. Establish the survey findings.
A rural bus shelter programme was announced twice with the same funding. Establish what was actually built.
A closed swimming pool is still drawing a maintenance charge. Establish who authorises the payments.
A highways contract was awarded without the usual tender notice. Establish the timeline and the sign-off.
